causal_errors.evidence: Baseline NC State fair -6.462, source-observed market NC State -6.5, Build16 fair -8.869; 2.407 incremental challenger-only advantage. External bookmaker quote not in native time-attested archive.
causal_errors.model_action: Require explicit risk hold when source verified line has baseline almost exactly market and challenger alone crosses cover threshold; preserve scoring means

causal_errors.evidence: Neither team interception or fumble lost, neither team defensive/ST touchdown; equal 4 TD each

causal_errors.evidence: Stanford was 4-1 home and 0-3 road after game; prior away losses unusually severe but opponent quality major confounder

implemented_decision_rule.description: New risk gate distinguishes cases where challenger alone has margin edge against a verified market spread while baseline is neutral or opposite; no numerical scoring rewrite or hindsight feature.
implemented_decision_rule.quote_limitation: Original frozen market was obtained externally rather than timestamp-verifiable native quote; counterfactual not a claim original engine produced this hold.
